kvkk.title: KVKK Privacy Notice

cerez-politikasi.title: Cookie Policy
cerez-politikasi.content:
This Cookie Policy explains how {{seller.name}} (“we”) uses cookies on {{seller.website}}, in line with KVKK and applicable rules.

1. What are cookies?
Small text files stored by your browser to keep sessions, carts, security, and measure performance.

2. Types we use
a) Strictly necessary: core site functions (session, cart, security, language).
b) Functional: remember preferences.
c) Analytics / performance: anonymous or pseudonymous usage stats; no marketing profiling without consent.
d) Payment / security: PayTR and similar providers may set their own security cookies for 3D Secure and fraud prevention.

3. Managing cookies
You can delete or block cookies in browser settings. Blocking required cookies may break cart, login, and checkout.

4. Retention
Session cookies expire when you close the browser. Persistent cookies are kept for reasonable periods then deleted or anonymized.

5. Third parties
Carriers, PayTR, email/SMS, analytics, and hosting partners may use cookies only as needed to provide the service.

6. Contact
Cookie and KVKK requests: {{seller.email}}

iptal-iade.title: Cancellation & Returns Policy
iptal-iade.content:
{{seller.name}} follows Turkish consumer law and the Distance Contracts Regulation.

1. Order cancellation
Before payment or before shipment, email {{seller.email}} to cancel.

2. Withdrawal (14 days)
From delivery date, withdraw without reason via {{seller.email}}.

3. Non-returnable items
Opened food/supplements where hygiene prevents resale; personalized goods; used or damaged items (except defects).

5. Refunds
Within 14 days after we receive and inspect the return, to the original payment method.
